title: Were You Old Then Too?
description: At Kid-2's football practice, Grandma reminisces about watching his dad play when he was young. Kid-2 responds with a question that quickly brings the nostalgic moment back down to earth.
alt: At a youth football practice, Pa and Grandma sit along the sideline while Kid-2 stands nearby in his football uniform holding his helmet. Grandma looks at Kid-2 and says, 'Feels like just yesterday I was watching your dad out there.' Kid-2 replies, 'Were you old then too?' Pa looks on with an amused expression while other young football players practice in the background.
